$comment: Design-system registry for CC dialed-UI enforcement (Wave A foundation). One entry per frontend repo, keyed on objective.project. Consumed by design-context.ts (loadDesignRegistry/isUiObjective) and scripts/ui-conformance.sh. Token paths are repo-relative: resolve as /home/operator/projects/<project>/<tokensFile>. Schema per research 03-agent-mechanism.md §1.1.

bannedSignals: inline style={{ with hardcoded color literal
bg-gray-* / bg-indigo-* / text-gray-* raw Tailwind palette
rules: Colors come from Tailwind token classes (surface-{0-4}, fg-{0-3}, line, accent, status-*, agent-*) — never raw hex.

bannedSignals: inline style={{ with hardcoded color literal
rules: Use --ws-* CSS variables / ws: Tailwind namespace only; read src/design-system/tokens.css before styling.
Neon #A8FF3F is indicator-only (≤5% of any screen).
Reuse Ws* primitive components; do not hand-roll buttons/inputs/cards.

example-platform.note: No bespoke design system — highest slop-risk repo. Use shadcn CSS variables / Tailwind semantic classes, never raw hex. New visual identity is a Designer-agent job, not inline conformance.
bannedSignals: inline style={{ with hardcoded color literal
bg-gray-* / bg-indigo-* / text-gray-* raw Tailwind palette
rules: Use shadcn semantic classes (bg-background, text-foreground, bg-primary, text-muted-foreground, …) — never raw hex or raw palette grays.
Reuse @/components/ui shadcn primitives; do not hand-roll equivalents.

bannedSignals: inline style={{ with hardcoded color literal
bg-gray-* / text-gray-* raw Tailwind palette (use the --z-* neutral ramp)
rules: Light-first; dark variants under [data-theme="dark"]. Colors come from the --z-* neutral ramp and --brand* forest-teal/lime brand ramp.
Do not invent new tokens — extend app/globals.css if a token is genuinely missing.
